questions.prompt: In a text-to-mel pipeline, what does the acoustic model predict?
options: A transcript alignment for the recognizer
questions.explanation: The acoustic model maps text representations to features such as mels; a vocoder produces the waveform.

questions.prompt: Predicted phoneme durations are too short. What symptom would you inspect?
questions.explanation: Durations determine how text units expand over frames. Short durations can compress articulation.

questions.prompt: Training improves but held-out samples degrade. What should decide the next checkpoint?
questions.explanation: Training fit is insufficient. Use validation measurements and listen to fixed held-out examples.
